full_name: Elizabeth Otto | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Humanities Catherine A. and Mary C. Gellert Fellow University at Buffalo
bio: The art historian Elizabeth Otto is the author, coauthor, or editor of 12 books and one of the foremost experts on the Bauhaus, arguably the 20th century’s most influential art and architecture school. While most studies focus on iconic figures in exile after the Bauhaus’s 1933 closure, in the history she will write at Radcliffe, Otto considers the majority of the school’s 1,400 members—over 80 percent—who remained in Germany and Nazi-occupied Europe.
